question: Does Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B put the right label first more often than cosine similarity, when suggesting a label for a reviewer to confirm?
decision: Which method fills the suggested label in the review queue.
approval: Operator approved plan, 639 MB download via llama download -hf, and run on 2026-10-12 ('run 17').

H1.statement: max(Route A, Route B) top-1 correct >= 46 of 67 labelled test cases.

hypotheses.H0: Both routes get 45 or fewer right.

decision_rule.pass: Reranker becomes the recommended suggestion engine for a later production proposal.
decision_rule.modest: H1 fails but a route beats the cosine baseline on the same shortlist: operator decides.

baselines.cosine_same_shortlist: computed in-run with Route A's suggestion rule

stats.test: count rule 46 of 67; paired counts against the cosine baseline

gates.G1_integrity: GGUF size and SHA-256, server binary and input pins verify before and after
gates.G2_completeness: every case has a valid reranker result in both routes; errors count as wrong
gates.G3_fold_hygiene: shortlists come only from the outer gallery; injected leak refused

reranker.location: shared Hugging Face cache via llama download -hf

server.binary: llama.cpp b11510 from the Experiment 03 manifest

routes.A: rerank the 10 nearest outer-gallery observations (Experiment 16 instruct cosine); suggestion = label of the first reranked observation with an existing label
routes.B: rerank every same-section label definition; suggestion = top label
routes.cosine_baseline: Route A shortlist in cosine order, same suggestion rule

frozen.query: observation description; built-in model instruction unchanged

exploratory.safety_ceiling: best zero-wrong correct count when ranking Route B suggestions by top score; Tier 1 needs 29
